itens.trecho: Sem uma liderança carismática, boas personagens ou uma boa história, é muito mais fraco do que o pior dos filmes de Harry Potter. O universo de Harry Potter tornou-se num dos fenómenos cinematográficos mais lucrativos e marcantes que conhecemos. Pessoalmente, sou um de muitos adolescentes que leu os livros e viu os filmes todos.

Hats have to come off here to Eddie Redmayne. I reckon he must have spent virtually all of the filming days staring at a green screen reacting to CGI. That's my problem with this. Though set in a fantasy world, there's nothing remotely authentic about it.

Personally I found this movie to be 2+ hours of excellent entertainment. This is one of these movies where I simply cannot understand how people can give one and two star ratings stating that it is garbage etc. I do not get what these people expected? Maybe they just have to complain?
